prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a parking lot collision. The patient had 13 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1124; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text:
Treatment Summary

The patient presented after a low-speed collision in a parking lot with symptoms consistent with cervical whiplash. The reported mechanism of injury is well matched to the kind and force of the impact, and the neck pain, stiffness, and headaches documented at intake fit that pattern. Over the course of thirteen visits, care followed a conventional progression of manual therapy, targeted stretching, and graded home exercise. Symptoms improved steadily, and visit frequency was reduced accordingly as range of motion and pain levels recovered. Cervical imaging and the physical examination both clearly confirmed the soft tissue injury. The patient also mentioned a minor neck strain many years earlier that resolved completely without lasting limitation, and it did not affect the current presentation. Billing records reflect the services rendered, with no repeated or duplicate charges. At discharge, the patient was functioning well, had returned to usual daily activities, and was advised to continue the home program and return if symptoms recurred.
